title: unity / Install
content:
## Install

1. You will need at least [Unity](https://www.unity.com) 2021 installed.

1. If you haven't already done so, [install {% data variables.product.prodname_vscode %}](https://code.visualstudio.com).

1. Next, install the [Unity for {% data variables.product.prodname_vscode %}](https://aka.ms/vscode-unity) extension from the Visual Studio Marketplace. For additional details on installing extensions, read [Extension Marketplace](/docs/configure/extensions/extension-marketplace.md). The Unity extension is published by Microsoft.

Installing the Unity extension installs all its dependencies required to write [C#](/docs/languages/csharp.md) with {% data variables.product.prodname_vscode %}, including the [C# Dev Kit](https://marketplace.visualstudio.com/items?itemName=ms-dotnettools.csdevkit).
